name: NOUN BOT
purpose: Personalized NOUN student operating layer under InstituteGPT for academic support, student services, progression, opportunities and continuity.
identity_model: One persistent learner identity spans certificate, undergraduate, postgraduate diploma, master's and PhD stages and multiple programmes.
authority_model: Students control their accounts and consequential requests; institutional actions remain user-controlled or institution-authorized and are never impersonated by the AI.
abba_role: NOUN-specific product orchestration under InstituteGPT and canonical ABBA, with human escalation for consequential or ambiguous matters.
pulse_model: Study questions, learning sessions, requests, progression signals and service outcomes are recorded as auditable activity/Pulse where persistence is appropriate.
value_measurement_model: Measures learning effort, time, evidence, capability, service fulfilment and progression independently from money.
provenance_model: Official claims carry source, authority, freshness and verification metadata; secondary evidence is distinguished from official evidence.
security_model: Uses canonical identity, tenant, authorization, privacy, audit and Ash/Phoenix boundaries; private academic data is never implicitly marketplace-public.
recovery_model: Learner continuity is recoverable through verified identity, persistent context, Supabase history, audit trails and human escalation.
data_lifecycle: Student records are tenant-scoped and purpose-bound; public marketplace publication requires deliberate student action.
